calls.title: Hello TV & Growthbook Commercial Proposal
calls.summary: Participants discussed the transition from VWO to Growth Book, highlighting budget constraints and management approval as significant barriers. Current expenditure on VWO is about €31,000 annually, while Growth Book’s Pro plan costs €2,600, though it has limits. Importance was placed on feature flag testing, which is currently limited in VWO, complicating experimentation. Randy proposed a phased approach, starting with Growth Book's Pro version to familiarize the team before a potential full switch when the VWO contract expires in September next year. The goal is to leverage Growth Book’s advantages while ensuring management buy-in, which might require demonstrating its effectiveness through a proof of concept.
calls.keywords: Feature Flagging, Experimentation, Growth Book, VWO, Budget Constraints, ROI
